title: CommitResponse
description: The commit that now holds the worktree's work on the slice's branch, or that there was nothing to commit.

oneOf.description: The changed and untracked files were committed to the slice's branch, and they are still in the worktree, which is clean.

folder.description: The worktree's folder, relative to the project.

branch.description: The slice's branch, forge/<slice>, which now ends at the commit.

commit.description: The new commit, in full. Its parent is the branch's head before, and its message is the one given.

oneOf.description: The worktree had no changed or untracked files, so no commit was made.

how.description: Nothing was committed, and the branch did not move.

folder.description: The worktree's folder, relative to the project.

commit.description: The branch's head, unchanged, in full.
